title: Vector Embeddings & High-Dimensional Vector Spaces

learningObjectives: Calculate similarity using Cosine & Dot Product

title: Document Processing & Chunking Strategies

learningObjectives: Select chunk size and overlap parameters
Evaluate retrieval quality vs chunk size

title: Hybrid Search & Cross-Encoder Reranking

learningObjectives: Combine sparse and dense retrieval scores using RRF

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Architecture
content: Building end-to-end RAG pipelines that ground LLM outputs with retrieved context documents.

title: RAG Triad Evaluation & Benchmarking
content: Automated benchmarking and quantitative evaluation of RAG systems using LLM-as-a-judge methodologies.

title: AI Agents, ReAct Prompting & Tool Execution

title: Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration
